source_refs.note: 5. Recreational Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Recreational activities such as boating, swimming, and camping can contribute to water pollution if not properly managed. Boats often release oil, fuel, and other chemicals into the water, harming aquatic life. Littering by visitors, including plastics, food wrappers, and other waste, can pollute lakes and rivers.
